target: Repo Truth Extractor failed sidecar redaction
invariants: No batch submit, poll, retrieve, or cancel.
Runtime-generated artifacts remain evidence surfaces, not source truth.
Secrets and secret-shaped values must not be quoted in proof outputs.
Preserve deterministic ordering and existing failure classification semantics.

pr.title: RTE-PKT-15: redact failed sidecar outputs
pr.body: Implements RTE-PKT-15-FAILED-SIDECARS. Scope is limited to failed sidecar redaction and tests. No provider calls, live extraction, batch provider operations, promptset edits, schema edits, model-map edits, route-policy edits, retry-semantics changes, or repair-semantics changes are authorized.

steps.task: Verify repo identity, branch/worktree safety, dependencies, and prior packet evidence before editing.
validation: Repo identity and branch deviation are recorded in PREFLIGHT.md.

steps.task: Map current failed sidecar writer paths and classify scope.
validation: Failed sidecar writer ledger lists in-scope and out-of-scope writers.

steps.task: Apply output-safety redaction to failed text and JSON sidecars.
validation: Failed text and JSON sidecars use failed-sidecar sanitizer coverage.

steps.task: Add targeted failed sidecar redaction tests.
validation: Focused output safety and failed sidecar tests pass.
Adjacent local regressions pass or substitutions are recorded.

steps.task: Generate proof artifacts and run secret-shape scan.
validation: Proof artifacts avoid quoting secret-shaped fixture contents.

steps.task: Inspect final diff, validate scope, and prepare commit/PR closeout.
